observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor breaks down the Hand Jive choreography step by step while adding humorous commentary with her co-presenter. They combine verbal explanations of arm and foot placements with live demonstrations and music trials.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction of the hosts and the topic of learning the Hand Jive from Grease.
Breakdown and practice of the first step (heel touches).
Breakdown and practice of the second step (toe scuffs/scars).
Breakdown and practice of the third step (hands dancing/cross).
Breakdown and practice of the fourth step (hip slicing).
Breakdown and practice of the fifth step (fists and scoops).
Practicing the steps so far with music.
Breakdown and practice of the sixth step (spreading fingers/shocking movements).
Breakdown and practice of the seventh step (iPad hands/head).
Breakdown and practice of the eighth step (knee slaps and elbows).
Breakdown and practice of the ninth step (quacking duck/chicken).
Final full run-through of the Hand Jive routine with music.

metaphors: alsof je een denkbeeldige iPad vastheeft
common_mistakes: losing breath due to fast movements

steps_taught.name: Heel touches
steps_taught.description: Stepping and tapping heels outward alternatively.

steps_taught.name: Toe scuffs
steps_taught.description: Scuffing toes in and out while standing on heels.

steps_taught.name: Dancing hands
steps_taught.description: Crossing arms and clapping hands in rhythm.

steps_taught.name: Hip slicing
steps_taught.description: Slicing hand motions near the hips with foot taps.

steps_taught.name: Fists and scoops
steps_taught.description: Fists together and opening outward in a scoop motion.

steps_taught.name: Shocking fingers
steps_taught.description: Spreading fingers and making sharp, shocking upper body movements.

steps_taught.name: iPad hands
steps_taught.description: Holding hands up like an iPad framing the head and moving down.

steps_taught.name: Knee slaps and elbows
steps_taught.description: Slapping knees and raising elbows upward.

steps_taught.name: Duck/Chicken
steps_taught.description: Quacking hand motion like a duck followed by a final pose.

what_works: Demonstrating both slow practice and practice with music
what_hinders: Fast tempo in the final routine can be overwhelming for beginners

quotes.text: Je doet dus echt al na acht tellen zeer kort adem

evidence_segments.observation: Two presenters standing side by side in a studio setting talking to the camera.
Instructor demonstrates foot heel touches while counting.

extraction.distinctive_method: Using humor, pop culture comparisons (like Friends and iPad), and a co-host who reacts in real-time to make the tutorial entertaining.
